## Checklist

For new entries:

- [ ] Wiki page added, based on the [entry page template](https://github.com/marcel-kuehn/gitignore-guide/blob/main/docs/_templates/entry-page.md)
- [ ] Group page updated (file list and snippet)
- [ ] Template updated
- [ ] Root `.gitignore` updated, if `templates/base.gitignore` changed
- [ ] README updated, if a new group, template or wiki section was added

For every pull request:

- [ ] Markdown formatted with `npx prettier@3.9.9 --write "**/*.md"`
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org)
